time_scope: One source/implementation/CPU/report interval. Parallel test invocations and their reported runtimes are nested and must not be added again.
activity: Implement a separate streaming, lossless, chunked archive for C07 raw fixture bytes.

archive_contract.input: An explicit regular fixture.pt within this campaign outputs directory. No discovery scan.
archive_contract.original: Read-only source. Keep the ignored raw file unchanged.
manifest: Readback result and final original hash match
archive_contract.completion: Publish complete manifest only after chunk readback, bounded decompression, decoded hash check, and final source hash/identity check.
archive_contract.overwrite_policy: Refuse an existing archive directory or restore output. Never merge or replace.
archive_contract.failure_policy: Keep partial archive directory without a complete manifest. Failed restore removes only its newly created temporary file and publishes no output.
archive_contract.reconstruction: Bounded stream decode. Verify all chunk/stream/original hashes before atomic no-overwrite output publication.
archive_contract.limits: File identity and hash checks detect ordinary concurrent changes. They are not a filesystem snapshot against arbitrary writers.
archive_contract.semantics: Opaque bytes only. No tensor deserialization, dtype conversion, quantization, filtering, or numerical tolerance.
